name: mayrit
description: Mayrit turns your AI assistant into your business advisor: plan, validate and launch your business, run by a cabinet of AI agents.

com.openai.interface.longDescription:
Mayrit turns your AI assistant into your business advisor. Tell it about your business in any way you like (a couple of sentences, your website, a spreadsheet with your plan, or the businesses and Instagram profiles you want to look like) and it guides you through the rest.

Mayrit is a method to set up your business fully automated and run by a cabinet of AI agents, so you focus on the business and leave the management to AI. It works in four phases, each with a fixed price for everyone (VAT included; all four for EUR 439):
1. Understand your business, "Is it worth it?" (EUR 49): catalogue, market and real local competitors, business model, fit, canvas and a verdict.
2. Face the market and the competition, "This is how your business would work" (EUR 69): competitors in depth, closed catalogue and prices, channels and AI agents, go-to-market, plan and investment.
3. Train it, "Does it hold up?" (EUR 125): the hypotheses to test, experiments and their instruments, and your agents and prices trained in simulations.
4. Deploy it, "Your business, set up and tested" (EUR 209): content and AI agents, website and shop, Instagram, all texts, what to contract, and the test results.

Every document is reviewed critically in several rounds and then by a second AI model before you see it. Your assistant tells you what is happening while Mayrit works, explains its conclusions and proposes the next step; you always decide. You pay each phase on Mayrit's website (Stripe); your assistant never sees card details. A live page, "Your sign-up", shows your phase, progress, documents and payments at any time.

Sign in with Google, or with a code sent by email, Telegram or WhatsApp. Available in Spain.
com.openai.interface.developerName: ANNA Cuidado Tecnico del Hogar, S.L. (Mayrit)
defaultPrompt: I want to open a small wine shop in Madrid. Is it worth it?
Help me turn my website into a business run by AI agents.
How is my business sign-up going?

positive.prompt: I want to open a small wine shop in Madrid. Help me check if it's worth it.
positive.expected_result: Mayrit creates the sign-up and returns the business id, the link to the live page "Your sign-up" and the questions still missing; the assistant asks them.

positive.prompt: Here is my website: https://example.com. Use it to answer what you can.
positive.expected_result: The assistant answers the questions it can from the website and confirms them in one block; the result lists what was saved and what is still missing.

positive.prompt: Let's start phase 1. How do I pay?
positive.expected_result: A payment link on Mayrit's website (/pagar/...) for EUR 49, VAT included. With the reviewer account it goes to the payment simulator (card 4242 4242 4242 4242); nothing is charged.
What is new, documents done out of total ("n of m") and the minutes left; the live page shows the same.

positive.prompt: Show me the competitors you found and their prices.
positive.expected_result: The relevant passages of the competition document and, on request, the whole document; the assistant explains the conclusions and proposes the next step without recommending.

negative.prompt: Book me a flight to Lisbon.
negative.expected_result: The assistant does not use Mayrit: it is not about setting up or running a business.

negative.prompt: Give me today's stock price of Apple.
negative.expected_result: The assistant does not use Mayrit.

negative.prompt: Write me a poem about the sea.
negative.expected_result: The assistant does not use Mayrit.

com.openai.review.commerce_description: Mayrit does not take payments inside the conversation. Each phase is paid by the user on Mayrit's own website (Stripe Checkout); the assistant only gives the link and never sees card details.

com.openai.publication.release_notes: First public release: sign-up in four phases, payment links on Mayrit's website, live progress and document search. Sign in with Google or with a code by email, Telegram or WhatsApp.
